metadata.description: Plumlayer — an agentic construction operating model. The Plumlayer plugin + precon harness for Claude Code.

plugins.name: plumlayer
plugins.description: Connect Claude to your Plumlayer project (cloud) and precon workflow skills. Create + onboard projects, read + record project entries through the hosted MCP; what you record counts as your word, carrying its authorship trail. Includes the scope-run engine: one grounded, cited scope list for the job, then derived trade packages.
